english.title: Fail to accord precedence to pedestrian / cyclist at parallel crossing

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[rider]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to accord precedence to a

(C)_[pedestrian]_
(D)_[cyclist]_

who was on the carriageway within the limits of an uncontrolled Parallel crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) before any part of your vehicle had entered those limits
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 22, Part 1, Schedule 14 of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:

(B)_[rode]_

**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) onto a Parallel crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) and in doing so failed to give precedence to

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

No endorsement or disqualification if offence committed in respect of a non-motor vehicle.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
